# {{ site.title | escape }}

> {{ site.description | escape }}

{{ site.title }} is the blog platform for F9XR Team, a digital architecture agency based in India with a global client footprint. We build high-performance web ecosystems, AI-powered systems, and local SEO infrastructure that generates measurable revenue.

## Key Topics

- Web architecture and Core Web Vitals optimization
- AI integration (GPT chatbots, workflow automation, lead scoring)
- Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, citations, reviews)
- Digital systems design and technical maintenance
- WordPress and custom framework development
